_comment: Findings known and accepted for this suite; see expected/fapi2.json for the format.

oidcc-userinfo-post-body.why: Versola refuses an access token in a form body on purpose (it was added and reverted, #543); the module only warns, and the spec leaves it optional.

oidcc-ensure-request-with-acr-values-suc.why: A SHOULD. Versola answers acr_values with an acr claim only when an existing session already satisfies the class; a fresh login returns none. Open gap, no issue yet.

oidcc-codereuse-30seconds.why: A token issued from a replayed authorization code still works at /userinfo: versolauth/versola#729.

oidcc-unsigned-request-object-supported-.why: Skipped by the suite: 'none' is not in request_object_signing_alg_values_supported, because Versola does not accept unsigned request objects.

oidcc-ensure-request-object-with-redirec.why: Skipped by the suite for the same reason: it builds an unsigned request object.
